name: layout
label: Layout
description: Whether the radio buttons should be laid out vertically or horizontally

name: options
label: Options
description: Array of objects providing configuration for the options available within the radio group

name: value
label: Selected option
description: Contains the `id` value of the option selected by the user, or the first option passed in with a `checked` value

name: manageValue
label: Manage value
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the value property. Use the value set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: name
label: Identifier
description: Name passed along in dispatched actions. Required. If an identifier is not provided, the radio group will not function correctly

name: readonly
label: Read-only
description: By enabling this property, the user cannot modify the value of the field. The field is not disabled in this setting

name: label
label: Label
description: Label describing the overall purpose of the radio group field

name: wrapLabel
label: Wrap label
description: Wraps the label if it does not fit on one line

name: helperContent
label: Helper text
description: Whether to include an iconic button with popover next to the field label for displaying additional hint text to the user. Use plain text to allow the text to be translatable

name: optional
label: Optional
description: Visually indicates that the field is optional

name: required
label: Required
description: This property allows you to indicate that the user must enter a value in the field before proceeding

name: hideRequiredIndicator
label: Hide required indicator
description: When true, the required indicator is visually hidden. Use this for forms where most fields are required, along with the `optional` flag for any fields that are not required

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: Set this flag to indicate that the field is in an incorrect state, which will be visually reflected in the field display

name: manageInvalid
label: Manage invalid
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the invalid property. Use the invalid set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: messages
label: Alert messages
description: Array of inline alert messages that are displayed below the field

name: fieldLayout
label: Field layout configuration
description: Configuration for the field layout. Determines whether the labels, field and slotted content are arranged vertically or horizontally, and their respective proportion in a horizontal container
